facts: The Jaibos won the first league title in club history on April 5, 2026, beating Delfines de Puerto Vallarta 4 games to 2. The clincher went to extra innings, 10-7, in Vallarta.
It was their second straight trip to the final. A year earlier, Tabaqueros de Santiago beat them 4 games to 2. This time they knocked out Coqueros de Tuxpan 4-2 in the semis and finished the job.
A jaiba is a crab. The Jaibos are Sayulita's crabs, and the kids' team is the Jaibitos.
Baseball in Sayulita goes back to at least the 1970s. The club is run by volunteers and community donations.
Home is Estadio Manuel Rodríguez Sánchez on the north side of town. Sunday afternoon games are a tradition.
The league is the Liga Nayarita de Béisbol "Germán Jiménez Camarena", a winter league founded in 2000 for Nayarit-born players plus a few veterans.
Playoff series are best of seven. Six teams make the playoffs.
The league is named for Germán Jiménez Camarena, a lefty from Santiago Ixcuintla, Nayarit, who pitched for the Atlanta Braves in 1988. His only big-league win came against the Mets at Shea Stadium.
The Bahía de Banderas municipality pays for the team's bus rides to away games.
Want pro ball too? Jaguares de Nayarit play in the Mexican Pacific League in Tepic, which opens its season in mid-October.
